owner: CC (probe + ticket + crossings); Akien (the ruling that made this the starting place: decision 2026-08-07-the-implementation-order, confirmed same day
children: none, because the build is one probe file plus this ticket — no decomposition to spawn. The future consumer of the counts (the dial over /intent's questions) is named in the charters and deliberately NOT spawned here: a manager for an empty room.
workflow_and_state: skill@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(idea-capture-pickup) -> [PROVED]

watchme.trigger: every pulse reaching the skill's shim — the probe globs CairnCommons/ideas/ against answers.from_idea on /intent's live berths (files only: no device, no bus, no network) and fires when >= 12 captures stand uncited. Rot is the pattern it fires on, not absence of pickups: a queue where twelve rot while three get picked is still rotting, and the three would mask a picked==0 clause.
watchme.enough: cleared once working the queue is demonstrated AT SCALE: >= 12 captures picked up through the door AND fewer than 12 standing. A POPULATION claim on purpose — the existence claim ('capture -> pickup works end-to-end') was measured live 2026-08-07, when capture 2026-08-07-yes-we-need-to-build-out-idea was cited by two /intent births within the hour, and a watch standing on a settled question is the re-derivation Law 1 refuses. Trigger and clear are mutually exclusive by construction, so the roster's recorded clear-before-fire bug cannot be rebuilt here by drift. Akien may also retire the watch by ruling.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier — captured/picked/unpicked counts plus the rotting ids BY NAME, so the poke is complete on the first pass and the owner never re-runs the survey to learn which twelve
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the claim is a prediction about how the queue behaves once capture is frictionless, and a prediction that did not hold belongs in the tree that remembers what killed which
watchme.consumer: Akien, through the owner's gate. The probe deposits and pokes; the rot pattern's two readings (the queue is not being worked, or ideas are consumed off-door) are his fork to call, and any back-edge on /idea's charter is his act (Law 6).
